gemini.title: Wfd River Water Bodies Cycle 3
gemini.abstract: Wfd River Water Bodies Cycle 3 is an authoritative dataset published by Environment Agency. It represents wfd river water bodies cycle 3 features using multilinestring geometry.
gemini.lineage: Published by Environment Agency as open environmental data. Loaded into Systra PostGIS database without transformation.
